anime-series.details: Seven exact Muse India JoJo Hindi-dub episode leads (S2E22/E27 and S3E1/E4/E9/E10/E14) were found. All lack current direct watch/oEmbed, runtime and India country metadata verification, so they remain pending.

anime-movies.details: Doraemon, Pokémon films, Suzume and Ne Zha searches produced no authorized full-feature candidate. A Ne Zha Hindi-dub claim from BANGLA Video was unreviewed and rejected; no theatrical feature was added.

movies.details: Official distributor searches produced no exact new full Hindi/English movie that passed all gates. Korean Classic Film leads are not eligible as Other Movies without Hindi or English audio evidence.

k-dramas.details: My Golden Life EP2 and EP3 were rediscovered on KBS WORLD TV, but title subtitle labels alone do not establish actual English subtitle tracks; runtime, per-video uploader identity, embeddability/oEmbed and IN metadata remain unverified.

limitations: Direct YouTube watch-page access returned throttling/disabled errors for tested uploads; public oEmbed and Atom-feed access was disabled in this environment.
The local Desktop Commander device was offline, so build.py, scripts/audit.py, unit tests and node --check could not be run locally. No catalogue file was changed in this run.

The production homepage and sitemap could not be fetched by the available web reader. The prior main commit has a successful Vercel status, but this run cannot claim a fresh live-site/sitemap inspection.
Actual India playback remains unobserved. Country metadata, when present in prior reports, is not a playback guarantee.

result.reason: No new candidate passed every required verification gate.
